name: adac-language
description: Syntax highlighting, live error checking, snippets and build commands for the adaC programming language (.adac). Includes support for std::pc, std::db, std::web, std::ui and std::unicode libraries.

commands.title: adaC: Build and Run Current File

adac.compilerPath.description: Path to the adaC compiler executable (adac or adac.exe). Leave as 'adac' if it is in your PATH.

adac.libPath.markdownDescription: Extra library search path passed as `-L <path>` to the compiler. The compiler already searches `libs/` and `lib/` relative to the source file.

adac.checkOnChange.description: Check the file for errors while you type (without saving). When off, it is checked on open and on save.

adac.checkDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before checking.

adac.strict.description: Pass --strict to the compiler: assigning to an undeclared variable is an error.

adac.showWarnings.description: Show compiler warnings (for example, a probable typo in a variable name).
